decision_ref: Owner in the project thread 2026-10-16 15:52-15:56Z: nightly health check (İyileşme) at 00:05, code-only, findings in the morning digest, urgent ones by mail; Hamle never deploys its own changes.
rules: Runs from worker.py --mode health_check (job hamle-health-check, scheduler '5 0 * * *' Europe/Istanbul). No model call. Writes only health-check-YYYYMMDD and, for red findings, ONE mail health-alert-YYYYMMDD to alert_recipients (agency addresses only). The image reads work/hamle-account-manager/chain-profile/health-check-config.json, so a rebuild (package_chain_source.py) is needed after editing.
